slides.head:
Twelve-hour shift,
then two hours
of revision?
slides.body: That plan was never going to work.

slides.head:
You get home.
You skip it.
slides.body: By Friday, the whole week is behind.

rows.text: It plans around your shifts, once they're in Google Calendar.
It puts every session in your calendar for you.
Miss a day, and it moves the work into your free time.

slides.head: Come back after a bad week, and your calendar's already sorted.
